tool_args.rationale: The coupled-memory ODE is strongly refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 1.5185 versus tolerance 0.045), so its parameters should not be trusted. The evidence does not show chaotic oscillations or refute all smooth mechanisms. Acquire the available open-branch discriminating probe to distinguish alternatives before fitting another model.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise to a stationary smooth model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The coupled-memory ODE failed fresh confirmation by a wide margin, and the available rows do not identify which alternative mechanism or branch is responsible.
Eight rows already failed to confirm the fitted ODE; more of the same short-horizon trajectories would not directly distinguish competing mechanisms.
A failed candidate model does not establish that all stationary smooth mechanisms are refuted.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the mechanism.
